key_insight: Symmetry-preserving circuits can still miss important many-body directions, and adding just the right extra generator connectivity can dramatically expand variational reach to the full relevant symmetry sector.
engineering_relevance: For VQE, circuit quality can improve more by choosing minimal connectivity that enlarges the accessible manifold than by simply increasing depth.
method: Studied XXZ and Hubbard VQE with symmetry-preserving nearest-neighbor generator circuits.
Analyzed the resulting dynamical Lie algebras and identified restricted accessibility in the default architectures.
Added minimal extra symmetry-preserving connectivity: one next-nearest-neighbor excitation for XXZ and one correlated double excitation for Hubbard.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the modified generator sets reconstruct the full orthogonal DLA in the studied symmetry sectors and yield near-unit ground-state fidelity in VQE simulations.
watch_item: The connectivity fix is model-specific, so finding the right minimal generator may require problem-dependent Lie-algebra analysis before hardware implementation.
paper_title: Connectivity Controls Variational Accessibility in Symmetry-Preserving Quantum Circuits
